current_article.title: Dance Under the Moon with Clefairy — Pokémon GO
current_article.text:
Updates
Dance Under the Moon with Clefairy
Dancing in The Moonlight
The event takes place from Wednesday, September 23, at 10:00 a.m. to Monday, September 28, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. local time in Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Indonesia, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Malaysia.
Featured Pokémon
During the event, Clefairy* will appear in large numbers in the wild for five minutes at 12:00 p.m., 1:00 p.m., 7:00 p.m., and 8:00 p.m each day.
*If you’re lucky, you may encounter a Shiny one!
Moonlight O'Clock
During the event, the following Pokémon might appear in large numbers in the wild for five minutes at 12:00 p.m., 1:00 p.m., 7:00 p.m., and 8:00 p.m.
Clefairy with a Special Background*
Jigglypuff*
Teddiursa*
Skitty*
Munna*
Bunnelby*
*If you’re lucky, you may encounter a Shiny one!
Timed Research
This event features two consecutive Timed Research opportunities. Trainers must complete the first Timed Research before moving on to the second.
First Timed Research
Complete the tasks to earn the following rewards.
1,000 XP
1,000 Stardust
Encounter with Teddiursa
Encounter with Skitty
Encounter with Lunatone
Encounter with Bunnelby
Encounter with Clefairy with a Special Background
and more!
This Timed Research will expire on Tuesday, September 29, 2026.
Second Timed Research
Complete the tasks to earn the following rewards.
Encounter with Clefairy with a Special Background
Encounters with Teddiursa, Skitty, or Bunnelby
And more!
Be sure to complete the Timed Research tasks and claim all rewards within three days of receiving them.
Bonuses
2× Catch XP
Please be aware of your surroundings and follow guidelines from local health authorities when playing Pokémon GO. Upcoming events are subject to change. Be sure to follow us on social media, opt in to receiving push notifications, and subscribe to our emails to stay updated.
—The Pokémon GO team
